manuscript_title: A masked-line ablation audit of a Gaia-ESO UVES MK (F/G/K) LightGBM classifier: what survives, and a train-test scale mismatch

metadata.title: ges-uves-mk-audit: masked-line ablation audit of a Gaia-ESO UVES MK (F/G/K) LightGBM classifier (code, trained model and feature matrix)
metadata.description:
This archive accompanies a methods note on masked-line ablation of a three-class (F/G/K) effective-temperature-bin classifier of Gaia-ESO FLAMES-UVES U580 spectra (4800 to 6800 Angstrom), trained with LightGBM. It contains: (1) the trained classifier (lgbm_mk.pkl); (2) the engineered feature matrix and labels (features.npz); (3) the analysis scripts and library code, including the per-class masked-line ablation with a class-matched, bin-matched random-window null, row-level flip counts and an exact McNemar test; (4) the revision analyses under artifacts/revision/ (scale-versus-spread decomposition of the polynomial re-normalisation effect, retraining under alternative continuum normalisations, luminosity-class composition and a Kiel diagram, line-set geometry, and a corrected Pickles template cross-check that did not reach its agreement gate); (5) the dated decision log (docs/decision_log.md) and the folder provenance note; and (6) the LaTeX source of the manuscript with a script that writes every quoted number from the JSON artifacts.

Underlying spectra are public through the ESO Science Archive Facility (Gaia-ESO Programme 188.B-3002). Recommended stellar parameters are from Hourihane et al. 2023 (A&A 676, A129). This deposit redistributes only the feature matrix derived from the Gaia-ESO spectra, not the raw spectra, and does not redistribute the Pickles library. Please cite the Gaia-ESO Survey (Gilmore et al. 2022, A&A 666, A120; Sacco et al. 2014, A&A 565, A113) when using the feature matrix.

Version 1.1.0 supersedes the unminted first deposit. DOI: to be assigned on Zenodo deposit.

files_to_attach.description: Trained LightGBM model binary (sklearn pickle; load via src/interpret/classifier.load_model)
Engineered feature matrix and labels: X (n=3032 spectra, 696 bins), y (FGK), wave_centers, train/val/test indices, gap_mask, ra_deg/dec_deg for spatial CV, median_imputer fit on training rows only
Held-out test metrics, StratifiedKFold and StratifiedGroupKFold CV summaries, and boundary-filtered sensitivity
Numerical-claims dossier mapping every paper number to its source artifact path and field
Masked-line ablation result family: headline gate evaluation, TOST equivalence, paired bootstrap, flip-rate decomposition, Mg b EW per-class measurements, line-match sweep
Permutation importance, TreeSHAP, and sliding-window occlusion outputs plus the three-way triangulation report
Independent-continuum re-derivation, uniform-weights retrain, 3x3 hyperparameter grid, polynomial-continuum appendix diagnostics
Original Pickles 1998 UVKLIB chi-squared cross-check outputs (superseded by artifacts/revision/benchmark_corrected.json; produced with a template-type map that was later corrected)

Revision analyses: scale decomposition, retraining under alternative normalisations, luminosity mix, recalibrated and stratified ablation, corrected Pickles cross-check, line-set table, and the macro-to-source index
Dated decision log, folder provenance note, reproducibility appendix, and the superseded manuscript drafts
